sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: The Dashboard gives you a real-time snapshot of your Google Workspace organization. All data is pulled live from Google using the permissions of the signed-in admin account.

sections.heading: Information Cards
paragraphs: The page consists of four information cards:

bullets.desc: The organization's total, used and free storage space.
Number of active and suspended users.
The latest accounts with quick access to their details.
Currently running bulk operations and their progress.

sections.heading: Active Jobs
paragraphs: Track the progress of running bulk operations from this card and cancel them if needed. The "View all" link takes you to the Job History page.

sections.heading: Data Refresh
paragraphs: Data refreshes automatically each time the page opens; the last update time is shown under each card.

callout.text: If a card shows a permission error, sign out and sign back in — some data requires additional consent.
